review.description: Adopt repository, priority-policy, profile and skill configuration as S1-S3. The description separates settings changes from work launch.
review.implementation: SaveRepository/SaveConfig/SaveProfile and SaveSkill/DiscoverSkills implement these settings. Prepared profiles and skill bundles are captured by Prepare, so later setting edits do not rewrite a prepared snapshot.
review.tests: S1 has the settings UI assertion; S3 has assessment cache/policy invalidation assertions. S2 references the explicitly opt-in real lifecycle, and the document retains gaps for profile/skill editing and invalid-input combinations.
